title: Case 017: Kitchen Extractor Fan Repair Request
initial_request: Extractor fan in kitchen does not seem to work (turn on). May be a simple technician fix. Thank you
overview: The tenant reported that the kitchen extractor fan did not appear to turn on. Northbridge Lettings contacted the landlord, who advised that a switch to the right-hand side of the hob needed to be switched on. The tenant located the button and confirmed the fan was working. The job was closed as completed without payment.
outcome: The tenant found the switch following the landlord’s instructions and confirmed that the extractor fan was working. The job was closed without payment.
